# SEC PACK

SEC PACK is an international trade and sourcing business focused on professional B2B procurement.

## Public product areas
- A4 copy paper: 210 × 297 mm; 75–80 GSM programs; 500 sheets/ream; OEM/private-label options where available.
- Lamination films: BOPP, PET and MPET applications for paper, board, printing and packaging.
- Water-based adhesives: paper, film and board lamination applications; technical documentation where applicable.
- Packaging materials: specification-led sourcing for printers, converters and manufacturers.

## Public resources
- Product portfolio: https://secpackco.com/pages/products.html
- Online supply center: https://secpackco.com/pages/store.html
- Knowledge Center: https://secpackco.com/pages/market.html
- Contact: https://secpackco.com/pages/contact.html

## Important
Supplier identities, purchase prices, target margins, private logistics routes, customer records, credentials and internal procurement data are not public information and are intentionally excluded.
